The error says "Unknown development outcome" — likely from lack of "outcome" key. I'll include outcome and keep source paths? Hmm. To minimize risk of a second validation failure caused by source form mismatch, I'll set them to keys since allowed_source_keys is explicitly listed in feedback. kind: "relation"
